_meta.description: A drone flight along the line, by a creator who gave permission to use it. 'video' is the YouTube video; 'stops' are the stations in the order the flight reaches them, with 't' the second in the video where the station comes into view (each checked against the creator's on-screen station label). Stills from the video are in photos.json under each station. The flight covers Phase 1 only; the Phase 2 stills come from the same creator's flight of 24 Oct 2026 (jqqYy_kCPQE), checked the same way. See UPDATING.md.
_meta.permission: InfraUnfiltered gave the owner permission to use their drone videos (owner, 2026-10-16); the owner shared these Line 4 videos in chat on 2026-11-11.
